query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a neighbor's rose bush, I had to spend ten minutes gently pulling thorns out of his fur and he still has a tiny pink scratch on his nose that he keeps trying to lick. Then on my way home I popped into the corner bakery and they just restocked their matcha croissants, I grabbed two and ate one while walking, it was still warm and the filling oozed out a little onto my jacket. Speaking of things I need to sort out, I want to cancel my pending order #W9284598, the reason is that I ordered it by mistake.
